appliedUpdates.description: Added `format` command using the custom `node scripts/format-tracked.mjs --write` script to provide workers an auto-fix capability.
Added notes about Windows filesystem EBUSY errors during test cleanup to windows-quirks.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Workers should be advised to run targeted tests (e.g., `node --test tests/mission/*.test.cjs`) rather than `pnpm test` when working on mission features, because the full test suite contains 9000+ tests and consistently times out.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature `features-state-machine` worker wasted multiple attempts and 300s timeouts on `pnpm test`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the project's max-lines limit for files (ESLint SEC-023 max-lines 500). Workers should proactively split large test files or implementations into smaller modules.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature `features-state-machine` worker was blocked by the pre-commit hook enforcing the 500-line limit and had to rewrite/split the test files.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For new JSON files, enforce atomic writes (write to .tmp then rename) rather than `fs.writeFileSync`. This matches the convention for existing files.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature `workspace-provisioner` incorrectly used `fs.writeFileSync` for `manifest.json` instead of following the atomic write pattern.
